title: Carvotanacetone from Saposhnikoviae radix restores skin barrier by regulating SP1 and Claudin-1.
authors: Jia, Liying; Ying, Weihong; Liu, Gairong; Yang, Peng; Zheng, Yizhi
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然化合物CARV通过SP1调控Claudin-1恢复皮肤屏障，含分子对接分析SP1与配体互作，但非TF-DNA结合体系，方法仅简单对接，与课题相关性中等。
abstract: This study aimed to investigate how Saposhnikoviae radix regulates skin barrier function. Bioinformatics analysis was conducted to identify the compounds in Saposhnikoviae radix and their target genes related to cell barrier function. Molecular docking analysis was performed to investigate the interaction between carvotanacetone (CARV) and key genes. The impact of CARV on skin barrier function was assessed in HaCaT cells treated with tumor necrosis factor-alpha (TNF-alpha) and interferon-gamma (IFN-gamma). The effects of CARV and specificity protein 1 (SP1) on cell viability and permeability were analyzed. CARV effectively interacted with SP1. CARV attenuated the TNF-alpha/IFN-gamma induced impairment of cell viability and Claudin-1 expression in an SP1-dependent manner, as SP1 knockdown abrogated its beneficial effects on Claudin-1 and cell permeability. CARV, a compound derived from Saposhnikoviae radix, protects HaCaT cells from barrier dysfunction by upregulating Claudin-1 expression via the SP1.
abstract_zh: 本研究旨在探讨防风（Saposhnikoviae radix）如何调节皮肤屏障功能。通过生物信息学分析，鉴定了防风中的化合物及其与细胞屏障功能相关的靶基因。采用分子对接（molecular docking）分析，研究香芹酮（carvotanacetone, CARV）与关键基因之间的相互作用。在经肿瘤坏死因子-α（tumor necrosis factor-alpha, TNF-alpha）和干扰素-γ（interferon-gamma, IFN-gamma）处理的HaCaT细胞中，评估了CARV对皮肤屏障功能的影响。分析了CARV和特异性蛋白1（specificity protein 1, SP1）对细胞活力和通透性的作用。CARV能有效与SP1相互作用。CARV以SP1依赖性方式减轻了TNF-alpha/IFN-gamma诱导的细胞活力损伤和Claudin-1表达下降，因为SP1敲低消除了其对Claudin-1和细胞通透性的有益影响。CARV作为防风中的一种化合物，通过SP1上调Claudin-1表达，保护HaCaT细胞免受屏障功能障碍的影响。
